components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-voltage primary call-to-action button with signature glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF5C00; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(255, 92, 0, 0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff751a; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(255, 92, 0, 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subtle surface button for secondary interactions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1c1c21; color: #f4f4f5; padding: 10px 18px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #25252b; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Search & Message Input
components.description: Command-style dark input with luminous focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1c1c21; color: #f4f4f5; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 13px; outline: none; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #FF5C00; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #FF5C00; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #71717a; }

components.name: Mention Chip
components.description: Interactive clickable member mention pill with keyboard accessibility.
components.css: .ds-mention { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(255, 92, 0, 0.2); color: #FF5C00; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 92, 0, 0.4); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-mention:hover { background: rgba(255, 92, 0, 0.35); color: #ffffff; border-color: #FF5C00; }

components.name: Elevated Container Card
components.description: Deep obsidian surface container with 1px border stroke.

narrative.overview: Oit is engineered as an ultra-responsive, zero-latency collaboration hub for developers, open-source maintainers, and digital creators. The interface rejects generic corporate monotony in favor of an unapologetic, high-contrast dark aesthetic that feels immediate, tactile, and alive.
keyCharacteristics: High-Voltage Contrast: Deep #000000 void base with sharp #FF5C00 electric orange accents.
Tonal Elevation Hierarchy: Four discrete background tiers (#0a0a0c -> #121215 -> #161619 -> #1c1c21) creating structural depth.
Tactile Micro-Interactions: Snappy exponential easing (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)) and luminous border highlights.
Single-DOM Fluidity: Seamless transitions between chats, servers, and persistent background calls.

rules.name: The 10% Voltage Rule
rules.body: Electric orange is an active signal, never a wallpaper. It must occupy <=10% of any given screen area.

rules.name: The No-Gray-on-Color Rule
rules.body: On colored warning or alert surfaces, secondary text must be tinted from the alert hue, never washed-out gray.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All timestamps, durations, latency measurements, and unread counts use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) to prevent layout jitter.

rules.name: The Single-Border Rule
rules.body: Elevate with either a 1px border or a soft shadow, never thick double borders. Side-tab thick borders (border-l-4) are strictly prohibited.

dos: Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio for all body and informational copy.
Do ensure all icon-only interactive controls include descriptive aria-label attributes and keyboard event handlers.
Do apply loading='lazy' and decoding='async' to all media elements and user avatars.
Do constrain accent orange (#FF5C00) to interactive actions, active states, and real-time alerts.
Do provide immediate, high-signal feedback states for network latency, file upload errors, and room connection drops.
donts: Don't use generic saturated rainbow colors outside designated status tokens.
Don't use dated bounce easing; use smooth exponential deceleration.
Don't use asymmetric side-tab accent borders (border-l-4).
Don't allow interactive touch targets to drop below 40x40px on mobile screens.
Don't render unstyled browser defaults for scrollbars, caret colors, or text selection; always theme from the palette.
